usage: deskops queue job set [-h] [--root ROOT] job field value

Set one field (run, timeout, retry_exit_codes) of a queue job in
desk/config.json.

positional arguments:
  job          Job kind declared in queue_jobs
  field        Field of the job: run, timeout or retry_exit_codes
  value        JSON value (e.g. '[3]', 600, '["sh", "-c", "x"]'); anything
               else is a string

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
